title: At the Market
text:
Tom goes to the market with his mother. They need eggs, rice and tomatoes. The market is big and busy. Tom carries the bag because it is heavy.

At the fruit stand, the man sells oranges for one euro each. Tom wants six oranges. His mother pays and says thank you. They go home happy.

questions.text: Who goes to the market with Tom?
Why does Tom carry the bag?
options: He wants to help his mother

questions.text: Why do they probably go home happy?
options: They bought everything they needed and got good oranges
They did not go to the market

vocabulary.definition: a place where people buy and sell food and other goods
round fruits with thick orange skin

paragraph_translations: Tom va al mercado con su madre. Necesitan huevos, arroz y tomates. El mercado es grande y concurrido. Tom lleva la bolsa porque es pesada.
En el puesto de frutas, el hombre vende naranjas a un euro cada una. Tom quiere seis naranjas. Su madre paga y dice gracias. Vuelven a casa contentos.
